desc: Context Block accidentally rendered into the system prompt during a refactor — cache invalidated every turn
fix: prefix byte-identity test (test/invariants/cache-prefix.test.ts) gates every PR; assembleContextBlock must never touch the static prefix

desc: namespace omitted on a query path — cross-tenant data bleed
fix: namespace is a required arg at the data layer (D1 client, Vectorize wrapper, KV key builder); isolation test (test/invariants/tenant-isolation.test.ts) gates every PR

desc: Vault note write places retrieved content into a mid-conv system message — both untrusted-content risk and prompt-injection surface
fix: all vault/retrieved content goes in tool_result; system messages carry only operator context; ingested user/wiki content is DATA not directives (never alters agent instructions)

desc: LLM curator rewrites the index/notes destructively, losing history
fix: R2 object versioning ON + schema-validate curator output before write; never hard-delete on update
